blocked_actions.reason: Destructive schema/data changes are explicitly prohibited in incident scope and require change board approval
Security-sensitive changes require security approval and are outside the approved checkout diagnostics scope
Broad regional capacity actions are prohibited in incident scope and require separate approval

rationale: Scope boundary: Only checkout diagnostics actions are permitted; destructive, security-sensitive, and broad capacity changes exceed the approved incident scope
Risk boundary: Destructive and security-sensitive operations carry high risk and require formal approval gates to prevent accidental or unauthorized impact
Approval boundary: The incident scope explicitly limits changes to diagnostics only, requiring escalation to Change Board and Security Team for any out-of-scope actions
